description:
Desktop app that runs Claude Code, Codex, shells and SSH in one window.

Holler Bell is a free desktop app that runs Claude Code and Codex CLI sessions, shells and SSH connections in one window. Sessions sit under the folder they run in. When an agent finishes and waits for you, its session gets an amber mark and a notification. Free, at home and at work. No account. Not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI.
